title: Paneer and Spinach Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
400g (14oz) can of green lentils, drained and rinsed
CURRY PASTE: 4 garlic cloves, 3cm piece of fresh root ginger peeled, 1 red chilli deseeded, 1 tsp ground turmeric, 2 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tbsp garam masala, 2 tbsp water
method: Spray a sauté pan with oil and fry the paneer cubes for 3-4 minutes until the edges are starting to go golden brown. Scoop the paneer from the pan and set aside in a bowl.
Make up the curry paste: place all the ingredients into a mini chopper and whizz into a smooth paste.

Fry the onion in the sauté pan for 5 minutes, then add the curry paste: stir-fry gently for 2 minutes. Stir in the pepper, then the chopped tomatoes, green lentils and measured boiling water. Stir thoroughly and simmer over a medium heat for 15 minutes.
Stir the spinach into the sauce, remove from the heat, then spoon the yogurt on top. Leave it sitting on top of the sauce for 2 minutes before stirring it through.
Return the paneer to the curry, season to taste and serve scattered with coriander leaves.
notes: You can substitute the paneer for cubes of aubergine, butternut squash or sweet potato — fry with the onion in step 3, allowing them longer to simmer in step 5 (about 30 minutes).
